api.name: BhattScholze17.L30.construct
api.statement: Construct from n coefficients.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L30.characterise
api.statement: Equality is coefficientwise.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L30.transport
api.statement: Truncate full Witt vectors and compose finite truncations.

uses.how: Induction on n uses the existing finite coefficient rings.

items.name: Direct-limit perfect closure
items.statement: For a commutative characteristic-p ring, p prime, PerfectClosure R p is the quotient of pairs (n,x) by (n,x)~(n+1,x^p). This is the affine coordinate-ring construction used for scheme perfection.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L31.construct
api.statement: Construct the class of (n,x).

api.name: BhattScholze17.L31.characterise
api.statement: The successor Frobenius relation identifies (n+1,x^p) with (n,x).

api.name: BhattScholze17.L31.transport
api.statement: Use its existing perfect-closure maps when forming affine geometric adapters.

uses.how: Affine geometric perfection uses the colimit of Frobenius on rings.

items.name: Ordinary categorical core
items.statement: Core C retains objects and only isomorphisms, with composition and inverse inherited from C.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L32.construct
api.statement: Construct Core objects and morphisms from isomorphisms.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L32.characterise
api.statement: CoreHom is the isomorphism type in C.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L32.transport
api.statement: Include Core C faithfully into C and transport functors.

uses.how: The Segal construction takes the maximal subgroupoid.

items.name: Categorical nerve
items.statement: The nerve of C has n-simplices consisting of n composable arrows; its maps are induced by precomposition in the simplex category.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L33.construct
api.statement: Construct the n-simplex from n composable arrows.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L33.characterise
api.statement: Zero simplices are objects and one simplices are arrows.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L33.transport
api.statement: Apply nerveMap to a functor, preserving faces and degeneracies.

uses.how: Supplies N(Fin*) and nerves of groupoids.

items.name: Quasicategory predicate
items.statement: A simplicial set is a quasicategory when every inner horn admits a filler; this existing predicate supplies the concrete model, not its missing mapping-space and stable-category theory.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L34.construct
api.statement: Verify all inner horn fillers.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L34.characterise
api.statement: Expose the inner-index conditions 0<i<n.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L34.transport
api.statement: Transport along simplicial equivalences once their theory is constructed.

uses.how: Use the existing model before adding enhanced module categories.

items.name: Symmetric monoidal category predicate
items.statement: A symmetric category is a braided monoidal category whose double braiding is the identity.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L35.construct
api.statement: Supply a monoidal category and symmetric braiding.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L35.characterise
api.statement: Double braiding is identity for every pair of objects.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L35.transport
api.statement: A symmetric monoidal functor must preserve this braiding.

uses.how: The determinant must preserve the signed braiding.

items.name: Ordinary unbounded derived category
items.statement: For an abelian category C with a chosen localization, DerivedCategory C is the category of integer cochain complexes localized at quasi-isomorphisms.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L36.construct
api.statement: Choose HasDerivedCategory.standard in the required universe.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L36.characterise
api.statement: Q sends quasi-isomorphisms to isomorphisms.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L36.transport
api.statement: Compare enhanced derived functors to this ordinary localization.

uses.how: Preserve the existing homotopy-category carrier during enhancement.

items.name: Tor bifunctor
items.statement: In an abelian monoidal preadditive category with projective resolutions, Tor C n left-derives tensoring in the second factor; higher Tor vanishes for projective second argument.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L37.construct
api.statement: Apply the left-derived tensor functor in degree n.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L37.characterise
api.statement: For projective Y, Tor_(n+1)(X,Y)=0.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L37.transport
api.statement: Use its bifunctorial maps on both arguments.

uses.how: State the new characteristic-p vanishing on the existing homology functor.

items.name: Invertible module predicate
items.statement: Module.Invertible R M asserts that evaluation M dual tensor M→R is bijective.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L38.construct
api.statement: Provide bijective evaluation.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L38.characterise
api.statement: Identify the evaluation map with a linear equivalence.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L38.transport
api.statement: Transport through module isomorphisms and tensor products.

uses.how: Build line objects without a new module-level carrier.

items.name: Invertible sheaf category
items.statement: Use Tau Ceti’s full category InvertibleSheaf X of invertible O_X-modules. Its morphisms include noninvertible maps; Pic(X) takes its core.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L39.construct
api.statement: Form an invertible sheaf from the existing local rank-one condition.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L39.characterise
api.statement: Its underlying object is an O_X-module.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L39.transport
api.statement: Use the existing trivial sheaf and sheaf morphisms before passing to the core.

uses.how: Supplies objects for the Picard groupoid used in descent.

items.name: Finite projective splitting
items.statement: For a finite projective module over a semiring there are maps R^n→M→R^n with surjective first map, injective second map and composite id_M.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

items.name: Exact category of finite projective modules
items.statement: Tau Ceti equips the full finite-projective module category with the exact structure induced from modules; it equals the split exact structure.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L41.construct
api.statement: Use finiteProjectiveModulesExactStructure.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L41.characterise
api.statement: Its conflations are precisely ambient short exact sequences.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L41.transport
api.statement: Compare it to the split structure before group completion.

uses.how: Compare projective-module group completion with exact-category K-theory.

items.name: Scheme carrier
items.statement: A scheme is a locally ringed space locally isomorphic to Spec of a commutative ring; morphisms are locally ringed-space morphisms.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L42.construct
api.statement: Reuse Scheme and Scheme.Hom.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L42.characterise
api.statement: Affine neighborhoods identify the structure sheaf.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L42.transport
api.statement: Use existing fibre products and morphism properties.

uses.how: Perfection and projectivity extend this existing geometry.

items.name: Fppf topology on schemes
items.statement: Use the Grothendieck topology generated by jointly surjective flat locally finitely presented families.
items.note: Only the stated carrier or theorem is credited to the pinned library. Additional API/test specifications are not claims of existing formalization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L43.construct
api.statement: Form covering families through fppfPrecoverage.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L43.characterise
api.statement: Each arrow is flat and locally of finite presentation.

api.name: BhattScholze17.L43.transport
api.statement: Base change and compose coverings using the existing instances.

uses.how: Fppf descent is the first input to the h/v criteria.

items.name: Valuative covers
items.statement: For qcqs schemes, f:X→Y is a v-cover if every Spec V→Y from a valuation ring lifts to X after an extension of valuation rings V⊂W.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S201.construct
api.statement: Construct a cover from valuation-extension lifts.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S201.characterise
api.statement: Retain all valuation ranks, not only rank one.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S201.transport
api.statement: Pull back and compose covers, carrying the chosen lift witnesses.

uses.how: Allows approximation and reduction to valuation bases.

items.name: Refinement of a v-cover
items.statement: A refinement X′→Y of X→Y factors through X and is itself a v-cover.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S202.construct
api.statement: Supply a factorization and cover proof.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S202.characterise
api.statement: A factorization without a cover proof is insufficient.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S202.transport
api.statement: Compose refinements and pull them back.

uses.how: Replaces arbitrary covers by geometric presentations.

items.name: Subtrusive and submersive comparisons
items.statement: The valuation-extension criterion agrees with universally subtrusive morphisms; a v-cover is universally submersive, and a universally submersive map with noetherian target is a v-cover.

items.name: Adic detection of v-covers
items.statement: The embedding sending Spec R to Spa(R,R) identifies v-covers with surjections on the underlying adic spaces.

items.name: Flat covers
items.statement: A faithfully flat qcqs morphism is a v-cover.

items.name: Proper covers
items.statement: A proper surjective morphism is a v-cover.

items.name: h-covers
items.statement: Every h-cover is a v-cover.

items.name: Surjective non-v-cover
items.statement: Delete one exceptional point from Bl_0(A²_k). The map of the remaining scheme to A² is surjective but fails the v-cover condition for a valuation specializing in the deleted direction.

items.name: Rydh refinement theorem
items.statement: A finitely presented v-cover X→Y with Y affine has a refinement that is a quasi-compact open covering of a proper surjective finitely presented Y-scheme.

items.name: Inductive level of proper covers
items.statement: Level zero means refinement by a proper fppf map followed by a finitely presented nilimmersion. Level≤n adds an abstract modification whose restriction to the exceptional closed subset has level≤n−1, with the proper fppf and nilimmersion refinements of Definition2.5.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S208.construct
api.statement: Build the level-zero or successor factorization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S208.characterise
api.statement: Track the exceptional restriction and its smaller level.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S208.transport
api.statement: Base change a level witness and preserve the upper bound.

uses.how: Supplies the finite induction parameter in geometric and derived descent.

items.name: Finite inductive level
items.statement: Every proper surjective finitely presented morphism of qcqs schemes has finite inductive level.

items.name: h-topology
items.statement: On finitely presented S-schemes, the h-topology is generated by finitely presented v-covers.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S210.construct
api.statement: Generate a Grothendieck topology from these covers.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S210.characterise
api.statement: Compare generators to proper surjections and fppf maps.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S210.transport
api.statement: Restrict along base change with the finite-presentation condition.

uses.how: Provides the topology for the abstract blowup criterion.

items.name: Abstract blowup square
items.statement: A cartesian square E→X over Z→Y, with Z finitely presented closed, X→Y proper finitely presented and an isomorphism outside Z, is an abstract blowup square. The criteria may be tested with Y affine.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S211.construct
api.statement: Build E as X×Y Z with all four maps.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S211.characterise
api.statement: Check properness and the complement isomorphism.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S211.transport
api.statement: Base change the square and its hypotheses.

uses.how: The same square supports vector-bundle and derived patching.

items.name: Set-valued h-descent criterion
items.statement: A presheaf of sets on finitely presented S-schemes is an h-sheaf iff it is an fppf sheaf and sends every abstract blowup square with affine Y to a pullback square.

items.name: Space-valued h-descent criterion
items.statement: The same criterion holds for presheaves of spaces, replacing pullbacks by homotopy pullbacks.

items.name: Universal descent for a presheaf
items.statement: A map is of universal F-descent if its augmented Cech diagram computes F on the target and this remains true after every base change.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S214.construct
api.statement: Supply the Cech limit equivalence and every base change.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S214.characterise
api.statement: Separate descent for one map from universal descent.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S214.transport
api.statement: Compose universal descent maps and cancel on the right.

uses.how: Reduces general geometric covers to affine descendable maps.

items.name: Composition of universal descent
items.statement: If X→Y and Y→Z are universal F-descent maps, so is X→Z.

items.name: Cohomological h criterion
items.statement: For an abelian fppf sheaf F, if fppf derived sections send every abstract blowup square to a distinguished triangle, h and fppf cohomology of F agree.

items.name: Approximation of affine v-covers
items.statement: Every affine v-cover is a cofiltered limit of h-covers between schemes finitely presented over an affine base.

items.name: v-topology on qcqs schemes
items.statement: The v-topology is the topology generated by valuation-extension covers on qcqs schemes.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S218.construct
api.statement: Generate the topology in a fixed universe.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S218.characterise
api.statement: Covering families retain the valuation extension condition.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S218.transport
api.statement: Compare h covers and refinements into this topology.

uses.how: This is the topology of effective Witt-bundle descent.

items.name: Truncated space-valued v criterion
items.statement: For fixed finite n, an n-truncated space presheaf on qcqs schemes is a v-sheaf if it satisfies fppf descent, abstract blowup pullbacks and continuity under filtered colimits of affine coordinate rings.

items.name: Cohomological v criterion
items.statement: An abelian fppf sheaf with filtered affine continuity and the abstract-blowup cohomology triangle has v-cohomology equal to fppf cohomology.

items.name: Perfect schemes and geometric perfection
items.statement: A perfect F_p-scheme has invertible absolute Frobenius. Its perfection is the inverse limit of schemes under Frobenius, hence uses direct-limit perfect closures on affine coordinate rings. Perf is the category of qcqs perfect F_p-schemes.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S301.construct
api.statement: Glue affine Spec(PerfectClosure R p) charts.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S301.characterise
api.statement: Frobenius on every perfect affine coordinate ring is bijective.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S301.transport
api.statement: Construct X_perf→X and the universal factorization of maps from perfect schemes.

uses.how: All geometric descent and lattice functors live on this category.

items.name: Size cutoff for the perfect site
items.statement: An uncountable strong-limit cardinal cutoff supplies a small-enough category of qcqs perfect schemes stable under the constructions used here, including the valuation-product cover after increasing the cutoff as needed.

items.name: Quasi-compact under perfection
items.statement: A morphism of F_p-schemes is quasi-compact if and only if its perfection is quasi-compact.

items.name: Quasi-separated under perfection
items.statement: A morphism of F_p-schemes is quasi-separated if and only if its perfection is quasi-separated.

items.name: Affine under perfection
items.statement: A morphism of F_p-schemes is affine if and only if its perfection is affine.

items.name: Separated under perfection
items.statement: A morphism of F_p-schemes is separated if and only if its perfection is separated.

items.name: Integral under perfection
items.statement: A morphism of F_p-schemes is integral if and only if its perfection is integral.

items.name: Universally closed under perfection
items.statement: A morphism of F_p-schemes is universally closed if and only if its perfection is universally closed.

items.name: A universal homeomorphism under perfection
items.statement: A morphism of F_p-schemes is a universal homeomorphism if and only if its perfection is a universal homeomorphism.

items.name: Perfection preserves a closed immersion
items.statement: If a morphism of F_p-schemes is a closed immersion, its perfection is a closed immersion; no converse is asserted by this item.

items.name: Perfection preserves an open immersion
items.statement: If a morphism of F_p-schemes is an open immersion, its perfection is an open immersion; no converse is asserted by this item.

items.name: Perfection preserves a locally closed immersion
items.statement: If a morphism of F_p-schemes is a locally closed immersion, its perfection is a locally closed immersion; no converse is asserted by this item.

items.name: Perfection preserves etale
items.statement: If a morphism of F_p-schemes is etale, its perfection is etale; no converse is asserted by this item.

items.name: Perfection preserves faithfully flat
items.statement: If a morphism of F_p-schemes is faithfully flat, its perfection is faithfully flat; no converse is asserted by this item.

items.name: Picard group after perfection
items.statement: For a qcqs F_p-scheme X, pullback identifies Pic(X_perf) with Pic(X)⊗Z[1/p], functorially in X.

items.name: Ampleness survives and descends through perfection
items.statement: A line bundle L on a qcqs F_p-scheme is ample iff its pullback to X_perf is ample.

items.name: Etale-site invariance
items.statement: X_perf→X induces an equivalence of small etale sites.

items.name: Universal homeomorphisms of perfect schemes
items.statement: A universal homeomorphism between perfect F_p-schemes is an isomorphism.

items.name: Perfect finite presentation
items.statement: A map of perfect rings B→A is perfectly finitely presented when A is the perfect closure of a finitely presented B-algebra. The corresponding local scheme property is denoted pfp.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S310.construct
api.statement: Supply a finite-presentation model.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S310.characterise
api.statement: Require perfection of the model, not ordinary finite presentation of A.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S310.transport
api.statement: Transport a model under perfect base change and compose pfp maps.

uses.how: Finite models carry properness and positivity arguments.

items.name: Comparison of perfect models
items.statement: Finite-presentation models of a pfp perfect algebra admit common refinements through finite purely inseparable maps after suitable Frobenius shifts.

items.name: Local characterizations of pfp
items.statement: Perfect finite presentation can be checked on a suitable affine cover and then holds on every eligible affine chart.

items.name: Limit characterization of pfp
items.statement: For a morphism of perfect schemes, pfp is equivalent to its Hom functor commuting with cofiltered limits of perfect schemes with affine transition maps.

items.name: Descent of pfp objects along limits
items.statement: The category of pfp objects over a cofiltered limit of perfect schemes with affine transitions is the corresponding 2-colimit of pfp categories over finite stages.

items.name: Finite-presentation model over a perfect base
items.statement: A pfp morphism X→Y of perfect schemes is the perfection of a finitely presented morphism X0→Y.

items.name: Properness in Perf
items.statement: A morphism in Perf is proper in this paper when it is pfp, separated and universally closed.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S316.construct
api.statement: Combine pfp with separatedness and universal closedness.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S316.characterise
api.statement: Distinguish this from the ordinary finite-type definition.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S316.transport
api.statement: Check properness by finite-presentation models and base change.

uses.how: Every descent and projectivity assertion uses this convention.

items.name: Proper finite models
items.statement: A finite-presentation model X0→Y over a perfect base is proper iff its perfection is proper in Perf.

items.name: Frobenius-root ideal
items.statement: In a perfect ring R of characteristic p, the radical of (f) is the union of the ideals (f^(1/p^n)); it is a filtered colimit of copies of R with transition multiplication f^(1/p^n−1/p^(n+1)).

api.name: BhattScholze17.S318.construct
api.statement: Construct the root ideal and its transition maps.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S318.characterise
api.statement: Its image in R is the radical of (f).

api.name: BhattScholze17.S318.transport
api.statement: Base change to a perfect R-algebra and identify the image ideal.

uses.how: Filtered-flat ideal resolutions control Tor.

items.name: Root ideal flatness
items.statement: The Frobenius-root ideal of one element in a perfect ring is flat.

items.name: Tor vanishing for perfect algebras
items.statement: For a diagram B←A→C of perfect F_p-algebras, Tor_i^A(B,C)=0 for every i>0.

items.name: Finite Tor dimension of radical finite quotients
items.statement: For perfect R, a quotient by the radical of an ideal generated by m elements has Tor dimension at most m over R.

items.name: Unrestricted perfect-scheme derived base change
items.statement: For a cartesian square of perfect qcqs schemes and any K∈Dqc(X), derived pullback commutes with derived pushforward across the square.

items.name: Witt schemes and formal Witt schemes
items.statement: For a perfect scheme X, glue Spec W_n(O_X) into W_n(X); the compatible system in n gives the p-adic formal scheme W(X).

api.name: BhattScholze17.S401.construct
api.statement: Glue the finite Witt thickenings on affine opens.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S401.characterise
api.statement: Reduction W_n(X)→X is the characteristic-p special fibre.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S401.transport
api.statement: Construct the compatible restriction system and inverse-limit bundle category.

uses.how: Carries the finite-level and formal vector bundles.

items.name: Vector-bundle groupoids on Witt schemes
items.statement: Vect(W_n(X)) and Vect(W(X)) retain finite locally free modules and their isomorphisms, with compatible pullbacks.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S402.construct
api.statement: Construct a bundle and isomorphism in the finite or compatible formal system.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S402.characterise
api.statement: On affine X=Spec A use finite projective W_n(A) or W(A)-modules.

api.name: BhattScholze17.S402.transport
api.statement: Pull back along perfect-scheme maps and reduce in n.

uses.how: This is the object category in effective v-descent.

items.name: Acyclicity of affine Witt bundles
items.statement: For perfect affine X=Spec A and a finite projective W_n(A)-module M, the associated v-sheaf has derived v-sections M in degree zero.
items.locator: Theorem4.1(i), finite level; Theorem 1.2 (introduction form, for vector bundles in the h-topology)

items.name: Formal Witt acyclicity
items.statement: The same affine derived v-section statement holds for a finite projective W(A)-module via its compatible finite-level system.

items.name: Finite Witt vector-bundle descent
items.statement: For every n≥1, X↦Vect(W_n(X)) is a v-stack on perfect schemes.
items.locator: Theorem4.1(ii); Theorem 1.2 (introduction form, for vector bundles in the h-topology)

items.name: Abstract blowup cohomology triangle
items.statement: For a proper modification of noetherian F_p-schemes and any vector bundle on Y_perf, fppf derived sections on Y, X, Z and E form the abstract-blowup distinguished triangle.

items.name: Abstract blowup vector-bundle patching
items.statement: For that square, Vect(Y_perf)≃Vect(X_perf)×Vect(E_perf)Vect(Z_perf), as groupoids with a specified overlap isomorphism.

items.name: Reduction to a blowup and Serre vanishing
items.statement: After a covering refinement and thickening the exceptional closed subset, the modification may be treated as a blowup with effective Cartier exceptional divisor and relatively ample ideal; high associated-graded ideal cohomology vanishes.

items.name: Frobenius extension of bundle gluing
items.statement: An overlap isomorphism lifts after a sufficiently large Frobenius pullback to a thickening nE, and then successively to every thickening; formal existence algebraizes the compatible isomorphisms.

items.name: v-topology is subcanonical on Perf
items.statement: Representable presheaves on Perf are v-sheaves.

items.name: Affineness does not descend for perfect v-covers
items.statement: The inclusion of punctured perfect A² into perfect A² is nonaffine, but its pullback along the blowup at the origin is affine.

items.name: Flat sheaves can fail h-descent
items.statement: For the punctured-plane open immersion j, the derived object Rj_*O becomes a flat quasi-coherent sheaf after the blowup h-cover, yet is not a flat sheaf on the original plane.

items.name: Hom between Witt bundles is a v-sheaf
items.statement: For two finite projective Witt bundles E1,E2 over perfect X, the presheaf on Perf/X taking pullback Hom is a v-sheaf.

items.name: Translation from schemes to perfections
items.statement: For a space presheaf F on Perf, F is a v-sheaf iff X↦F(X_perf) is a v-sheaf on qcqs F_p-schemes.

items.name: Picard groupoid of a scheme
items.statement: Pic(X) is the core of the invertible-sheaf category, with tensor product, unit and dual. Its object classes form Pic(X), while Aut(O_X)=Γ(X,O_X)×.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D501.construct
api.statement: Take the core of invertible sheaves and its tensor structure.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D501.characterise
api.statement: Keep automorphisms as well as line-bundle isomorphism classes.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D501.transport
api.statement: Construct symmetric monoidal pullback and compare with the ordinary Picard group.

uses.how: Line bundles descend as groupoid objects.

items.name: Graded Picard groupoid
items.statement: Pic^Z(X) consists of (L,f) with L a line bundle and f:X→Z locally constant; isomorphisms require equal gradings. Tensor adds gradings and the symmetry multiplies by (−1)^(fg).

api.name: BhattScholze17.D502.construct
api.statement: Construct graded lines and their isomorphisms.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D502.characterise
api.statement: The self-braiding of degree f is multiplication by (−1)^f.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D502.transport
api.statement: Pull back both the line and its locally constant degree.

uses.how: The determinant is symmetric only with this signed target.

items.name: Homotopy groups of graded Picard objects
items.statement: For a scheme X, π0 Pic^Z(X)=Pic(X)×H0(X_et,Z).

items.name: Automorphisms of graded Picard objects
items.statement: π1 Pic^Z(X) at the unit is Γ(X,O_X)×, and its higher homotopy groups vanish.

items.name: Graded Picard fibre sequence
items.statement: Pic(X)→Pic^Z(X)→H0(X_et,Z) is a fibre sequence of connective spectra once Picard groupoids are compared with such spectra.

items.name: Forgetting degree is not symmetric
items.statement: The functor (L,f)↦L is monoidal and splits the preceding sequence as E1-spaces, but is generally not symmetric monoidal and does not split it as spectra.

items.name: Graded Picard v-descent
items.statement: X↦Pic^Z(X) is a v-stack on perfect schemes.

items.name: Enhanced perfect complexes
items.statement: Perf(X) is the stable enhanced category of O_X-complexes locally equivalent to bounded finite locally free complexes, with pullback and coherent mapping spaces.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D508.construct
api.statement: Construct the full enhanced subcategory from local finite resolutions.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D508.characterise
api.statement: On an affine scheme compare with compact or dualizable modules over its ring.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D508.transport
api.statement: Pull back perfect complexes and identify their ordinary homotopy category with the existing derived carrier.

uses.how: K-theory and hyperdescent require this same enhanced category.

items.name: Scheme K-theory spectrum
items.statement: K(X) is the connective algebraic K-theory spectrum of the enhanced perfect-complex category, compatible with the Thomason–Trobaugh construction and with projective-module K-theory on affines.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D509.construct
api.statement: Apply the common K-theory functor to Perf(X).

api.name: BhattScholze17.D509.characterise
api.statement: Compare the affine model to K of finite projectives via the actual comparison theorem.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D509.transport
api.statement: Construct pullbacks and their composition coherence.

uses.how: A sheafified 1-truncation supplies the determinant.

items.name: Determinant of perfect complexes
items.statement: For every qcqs scheme X there is a natural map of connective spectra det:K(X)→Pic^Z(X), sending a finite projective module to its determinant and locally constant rank.

items.name: Additivity of determinant
items.statement: For a distinguished triangle C′→C→C″ of perfect complexes, det C is coherently identified with det C′ tensor det C″.

items.name: Witt complexes supported on the special fibre
items.statement: Perf(W(X) on X) is the full stable subcategory of perfect W(X)-complexes that become acyclic after inverting p. On affines this is the category of perfect W(R)-complexes supported at p=0.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D512.construct
api.statement: Take the kernel of localization to W(X)[1/p].

api.name: BhattScholze17.D512.characterise
api.statement: Support means derived acyclicity after p-inversion, not necessarily termwise p-torsion.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D512.transport
api.statement: Pull back along perfect bases and forget perfect O_X-complexes into this support category.

uses.how: This is the input of the special-fibre determinant.

items.name: Witt support K-theory
items.statement: K(W(X) on X) is K-theory of the support category; the forgetful exact functor Perf(X)→Perf(W(X) on X) induces a natural map α:K(X)→K(W(X) on X).

api.name: BhattScholze17.D513.construct
api.statement: Apply K to the support category and to the forgetful functor.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D513.characterise
api.statement: Distinguish support K from the fibre of K(W(R))→K(R).

api.name: BhattScholze17.D513.transport
api.statement: Pull back α and compare all support maps.

uses.how: The determinant extends along α.

items.name: Regular devissage for support K-theory
items.statement: If Y is a regular scheme and Z⊂Y is a regular closed subscheme in the qcqs noetherian K/G setting, K(Z)→K(Y on Z) is an equivalence.

items.name: Perfect regular-base Witt devissage
items.statement: If R is the perfection of a regular F_p-algebra R0, then α:K(R)→K(W(R) on R) is an equivalence.

items.name: Frobenius-colimit lift
items.statement: In the proof of Corollary5.6, start with a p-complete flat Z_p-lift A0 of R0 and a Frobenius lift φ. Set A∞=colim_φ A0; its p-adic completion identifies with W(R0_perf).

api.name: BhattScholze17.D516.construct
api.statement: Build A∞ from a specified compatible lift.

api.name: BhattScholze17.D516.characterise
api.statement: Keep the completion in the comparison with W(R).

api.name: BhattScholze17.D516.transport
api.statement: Compare reductions modulo p^n and supported perfect complexes.

uses.how: Transfers regular devissage to the Witt support category.

items.name: Supported perfect complexes and p-completion
items.statement: For the p-torsionfree A∞ in Corollary5.6, base change to its p-completion gives an equivalence of perfect complexes acyclic after inverting p.

items.name: Filtered-colimit K compatibility
items.statement: The K-theory comparison used in Corollary5.6 commutes with the Frobenius filtered colimit of the support categories.

items.name: Sheafified devissage
items.statement: On perfect schemes the map τ≤1 K(X)→τ≤1 K(W(X) on X) becomes an equivalence after h-sheafification, hence after v-sheafification.

items.name: Witt support determinant
items.statement: There is a natural map of connective spectra det-tilde:K(W(X) on X)→Pic^Z(X) extending det on K(X); it is unique up to a contractible space of choices.

items.name: Filtration formula for Witt determinant
items.statement: For a supported perfect Witt complex with a finite filtration whose gradeds are perfect O_X-complexes, det-tilde is the tensor product of their graded determinants, coherently independent of the chosen filtration.

items.name: Fully faithful pullback across connected proper fibres
items.statement: For a proper surjective pfp map f:X→Y in Perf with geometrically connected fibres, Vect(Y)→Vect(X) is fully faithful.

items.name: Witt-bundle full faithfulness
items.statement: Under Proposition6.1’s hypotheses, pullback is fully faithful also for Vect(W_n(Y)) and Vect(W(Y)).

items.name: Valuation-product cover
items.statement: A qcqs scheme has a v-cover Spec A where A is a product of representative valuation rings mapping to it. Each connected component of Spec A is a valuation-ring spectrum, and the closed-point subset is closed.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F603.construct
api.statement: Choose representatives at an adequate universe cutoff and form the product.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F603.characterise
api.statement: Identify the closed subset Spec(product residue fields) with the space of components.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F603.transport
api.statement: Base change to this cover and spread finite data from a component to a clopen neighborhood.

uses.how: Reduces bundle descent to valuation bases.

items.name: Ultrafilter valuation components
items.statement: Components of the product spectrum in Lemma6.2 are indexed by ultrafilters; the component ring is the filtered colimit of subproducts over the ultrafilter, hence an ultraproduct valuation ring.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F604.construct
api.statement: Form the filtered system of subproducts.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F604.characterise
api.statement: Use the ultrafilter alternative to prove the domain property and the valuation divisibility alternative.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F604.transport
api.statement: Identify clopen subsets with subsets of the indexing set.

uses.how: Justifies the valuation reduction for an infinite product.

items.name: Convex-subgroup valuation decomposition
items.statement: For a perfect valuation ring V and an ordered-value-group quotient Γ→Γ′, construct the localization V′, quotient valuation ring V0 and its fraction field V0′ as in Lemma6.3.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F605.construct
api.statement: Localize elements mapping to valuation one and quotient elements mapping below one.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F605.characterise
api.statement: Identify the common kernel ideal in V and V′.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F605.transport
api.statement: Base change the resulting ring square to a perfect V-scheme.

uses.how: Cuts a finite-rank valuation chain into lower-rank pieces.

items.name: Valuation decomposition exact sequence
items.statement: The maps of Lemma6.3 give 0→V→V′⊕V0→V0′→0.

items.name: Valuation decomposition for derived sections
items.statement: For any perfect V-scheme X and K∈Dqc(X), the three-term derived-section diagram after base change to V′,V0,V0′ is a distinguished triangle.

items.name: Finite-rank valuation approximation
items.statement: A valuation ring is the filtered union of its finite-rank valuation subrings obtained from finitely generated subalgebras; the corresponding maps of spectra are surjective.

items.name: Localization and reduction detect zero
items.statement: For a ring R, non-zero-divisor g and C∈D(R), if C[1/g]=0 and C⊗^L_R R/g=0, then C=0.

items.name: Residue tests may fail without noetherianity
items.statement: For a nondiscrete rank-one perfect valuation ring V with fraction field K and maximal ideal m, the nonzero complex K/m has zero derived base change to both K and V/m.

items.name: Triviality over a valuation base
items.statement: Let f:X→Spec V be proper pfp with V perfect valuation and RΓ(X,O)=V. A vector bundle trivial on every geometric fibre is trivial on X.

items.name: Cohomologically trivial fibre descent
items.statement: For proper pfp f:X→Y in Perf with Rf_*O_X=O_Y, E∈Vect(X) descends iff it is trivial on every geometric fibre.

items.name: Fibrewise cohomology detects the structure pushforward
items.statement: For proper surjective pfp f:X→Y in Perf, if RΓ(X_ybar,O)=k(ybar) at all geometric points, then Rf_*O_X=O_Y.

items.name: Frobenius splitting consequence
items.statement: For a proper finite-type model f0:X0→Y0 over a perfect field, if X0 is Frobenius split and the perfected map satisfies Lemma6.9, then R^i f0_*O_X0=0 for i>0.

items.name: Point fibres force an isomorphism
items.statement: A proper pfp morphism of perfect F_p-schemes with every geometric fibre equal to Spec of its field is an isomorphism.

items.name: Filtered torsion determinant line
items.statement: Let k be perfect and Q a finite-length W(k)-module. On perfect X/k let Q_X have a finite decreasing filtration with finite projective O_X-gradeds. Form the tensor product of their determinants.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F616.construct
api.statement: Construct the line from the given filtration.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F616.characterise
api.statement: Use O_X-linear determinants only on its graded pieces.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F616.transport
api.statement: Pull back filtrations and determinant identifications.

uses.how: Tests the determinant on geometric fibres of the Demazure resolution.

items.name: Fibre determinant triviality
items.statement: The line in Lemma6.11 is trivial on X, for every such filtration of a constant finite-length Witt module.

items.name: Bounded saturated valuation lattice
items.statement: For a spherically complete nonarchimedean field K with full real value group and valuation ring V, a bounded submodule M⊂K^r is m-saturated if M→Hom_V(m,M) is an isomorphism.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F618.construct
api.statement: Provide the embedding, boundedness and saturation comparison.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F618.characterise
api.statement: For r=1, saturation closes an open valuation ball.

api.name: BhattScholze17.F618.transport
api.statement: Transport under a linear isomorphism of the ambient finite vector spaces.

uses.how: Makes global sections of a fibre-trivial bundle finite free.

items.name: Saturated bounded modules are finite free
items.statement: Every module M in Lemma6.14 is finite free.

items.name: Descent using only connected fibres
items.statement: Let f:X→Y be proper surjective pfp in Perf with geometrically connected fibres. Then E∈Vect(X) descends to Y iff E is trivial on every geometric fibre; the descent is unique up to the unique compatible isomorphism.

items.name: Flat closure and normalization reduction
items.statement: In Theorem6.13 the perfect valuation-base problem reduces to a flat model integrally closed in its generic fibre after further v-covers and normalization; vector bundles glue across the special-fibre square.

items.name: Saturation of global sections
items.statement: For the normalized flat model in Theorem6.13, H0(X,E) is bounded in H0(X_eta,E_eta)≃K^r and equals Hom_V(m,H0(X,E)).

items.name: Partitions and dominance
items.statement: A partition λ is a decreasing eventually-zero sequence of nonnegative integers. Write μ≤λ when λ−μ is a nonnegative sum of the adjacent positive coroots, and λ−1 for subtracting one from each positive entry.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G701.construct
api.statement: Construct finite-support decreasing sequences and their transpose column counts n_λ(i)=#{j:λ_j>i}.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G701.characterise
api.statement: Relate dominance to partial row sums with equal total size.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G701.transport
api.statement: Transport partitions under zero padding and iterate the positive-entry subtraction.

uses.how: Indexes closed strata and the induction on their boundary.

items.name: Witt torsion module type
items.statement: For algebraically closed perfect k, a finite-length W(k)-module has type λ if it is the direct sum of W(k)/p^λ_i. Over perfect R take this type after base change to geometric points.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G702.construct
api.statement: Define geometric-fibre type through elementary divisors.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G702.characterise
api.statement: Record length and the ranks of p^i Q/p^(i+1)Q for constant type.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G702.transport
api.statement: Transport type under extension of algebraically closed residue fields.

uses.how: Supplies bounded and exact-type lattice functors.

items.name: Constant type gives projective gradeds
items.statement: For perfect R and a finitely generated torsion W(R)-module Q of constant geometric type λ, every p^iQ/p^(i+1)Q is a finite projective R-module of rank n_λ(i).

items.name: Dominance criterion 1
items.statement: For partitions λ,μ, the following criterion is equivalent to μ≤λ: λ−μ is a nonnegative integral sum of adjacent positive coroots.

items.name: Dominance criterion 2
items.statement: For partitions λ,μ, the following criterion is equivalent to μ≤λ: For every r the first r entries of μ sum to at most those of λ, and their total sums agree.

items.name: Dominance criterion 3
items.statement: For partitions λ,μ, the following criterion is equivalent to μ≤λ: For every m the sum of n_μ(i) over i≥m is at most the corresponding sum for λ, and their total sums agree.

items.name: Dominance criterion 4
items.statement: For partitions λ,μ, the following criterion is equivalent to μ≤λ: For every m≥0, length(p^m Q_μ)≤length(p^m Q_λ), with equality for m=0.

items.name: Isogeny of projective Witt modules
items.statement: An isogeny M1→M2 of finite projective W(R)-modules is a map becoming an isomorphism after p-inversion, with p-power-torsion cokernel; it is injective.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G706.construct
api.statement: Construct the map and its inverse after inverting p.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G706.characterise
api.statement: Use p-torsionfreeness to prove injectivity.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G706.transport
api.statement: Base change isogenies along perfect coefficient rings.

uses.how: Provides finite presentations and determinant valuations.

items.name: Isogeny cokernel criterion
items.statement: A finitely presented p-power-torsion W(R)-module Q is the cokernel of an isogeny of finite projective Witt modules iff its projective dimension is at most one.

items.name: Projectivity after reduction modulo p
items.statement: For a finitely presented R-module Q, viewed as a W(R)-module, Q is projective over R iff its projective dimension over W(R) is at most one.

items.name: Closed bounded-type locus
items.statement: For Q as in Lemma7.7, the locus of geometric type ≤λ is represented by a closed subscheme of Spec R; the type has locally constant total length.

items.name: Demazure filtration functor
items.statement: For a p-torsion W(R)-module Q of projective dimension at most one, Dem_λ(Q) parametrizes finite filtrations with finite projective O-gradeds of ranks n_λ(i), satisfying the specified p-step condition.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G710.construct
api.statement: Give every submodule, quotient and p-containment in the filtration.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G710.characterise
api.statement: Recognize its graded ranks from λ and its quotient isogenies.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G710.transport
api.statement: Pull back the full filtration, not just its isomorphism classes.

uses.how: Represents relative resolution fibres.

items.name: Filtration representability
items.statement: Dem_λ(Q) is a proper pfp perfect scheme over Spec R.

items.name: Witt support rank
items.statement: The support class of an isogeny cokernel has a locally constant integer degree, equal at geometric points to its Witt-module length.

items.name: Image of the filtration scheme
items.statement: Dem_λ(Q) has image exactly the locus type(Q)≤λ.

items.name: Filtered Grassmann incidence variety
items.statement: Let k be perfect, V a finite-dimensional k-vector space, F^mV (1≤m≤N) a decreasing filtration, and a_m integers with a_m≤dim F^mV. For 0≤n≤dim V and n≥a_m for all m, the closed Grassmannian locus of n-dimensional F with dim(F∩F^mV)≥a_m is projective, nonempty, and its perfection has RΓ(O)=k.

items.name: Exact-type uniqueness
items.statement: Over the exact-type λ locus the morphism Dem_λ(Q)→Spec R is an isomorphism.

items.name: Cohomology of filtration fibres
items.statement: Every nonempty geometric fibre of Dem_λ(Q) has RΓ(O)=its residue field.

items.name: Bounded Witt lattice Grassmannian
items.statement: For perfect R, Gr≤λ(R) classifies finite projective W(R)-lattices M⊂W(R)^n[1/p] with M⊂W(R)^n and Q=W(R)^n/M of type ≤λ. Gr_λ is the exact-type open subfunctor.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G801.construct
api.statement: Construct lattices as isogenies and form their quotient.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G801.characterise
api.statement: Recognize lower type bounds as closed subfunctors.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G801.transport
api.statement: Pull back lattices and compare bounds after multiplication by a power of p.

uses.how: The moduli target whose projectivity is proved.

items.name: Bounded Grassmannian is a v-sheaf
items.statement: Gr≤λ is a v-sheaf on perfect schemes.

items.name: Prior algebraic-space representability
items.statement: Zhu’s result gives Gr≤λ as a proper pfp perfect algebraic space. This is a cited alternate input, and is not used in the paper’s scheme-projectivity proof.

items.name: Global Demazure resolution
items.statement: The sheaf Gr-tilde_λ classifies the lattices of Gr≤λ equipped with the filtration of Definition7.10; ψ forgets the filtration.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G804.construct
api.statement: Construct the relative filtration functor over every lattice family.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G804.characterise
api.statement: Identify base changes of ψ with Dem_λ(Q).

api.name: BhattScholze17.G804.transport
api.statement: Compare refinements of filtrations through their common full-flag refinement.

uses.how: Provides the projective source on which the line is constructed.

items.name: Proper cohomological resolution
items.statement: The relative map ψ is representable by proper pfp schemes, surjective and an isomorphism over Gr_λ; Rψ_*O=O in the representable-base-change sense.

items.name: Smooth projective resolution tower
items.statement: Gr-tilde_λ is the perfection of a smooth projective variety built as successive Grassmann bundles.

items.name: First nontrivial boundary fibre example
items.statement: For n=3 and λ=(2,1,0), Gr-tilde_λ is a four-dimensional tower of two P²-bundles; the boundary type (1,1,1) is a point whose fibre is P².

items.name: Determinant line on the Grassmannian
items.statement: The tensor product of the determinants of the resolution gradeds descends to a line L on Gr≤λ; identify it canonically on every common refinement and under inclusions of bounds.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G808.construct
api.statement: Construct the line by cohomologically trivial fibre descent.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G808.characterise
api.statement: Compare its pullback with the tensor product of the graded quotient determinants.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G808.transport
api.statement: Use common full-flag refinements and full faithfulness to make the comparison across λ coherent.

uses.how: The ample line used for projectivity.

items.name: Ample weighted quotient determinants
items.statement: On the resolution, a tensor product of det Q_i with sufficiently rapidly decreasing positive exponents is ample.

items.name: Sections at the open stratum
items.statement: For any point of Gr_λ each det Q_i has a global section not vanishing at that point.

items.name: Ample, nef, big and exceptional locus interfaces
items.statement: For a projective finite-type model and line L, retain ampleness, nonnegative curve degree (nef), top self-intersection positivity (big), and E(L), the union of subvarieties where L is not big; compare these with pullback to perfection.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G811.construct
api.statement: Specify each predicate on a finite-type model and its pullback to the perfect scheme.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G811.characterise
api.statement: Relate curve degree, powers and positive top intersection under finite purely inseparable pullback.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G811.transport
api.statement: Show independence under a common Frobenius refinement of models.

uses.how: Provides the exact hypotheses of Keel’s criterion.

items.name: Strict positivity on Grassmannian curves
items.statement: The line L has positive degree on every nonconstant proper curve mapping to Gr≤λ; ψ*L is nef on the resolution.

items.name: Bigness and boundary exceptional locus
items.statement: The line ψ*L is big, and its exceptional locus lies in the inverse image of the boundary Gr<λ.

items.name: Keel positive-characteristic criterion
items.statement: On a projective scheme over a positive-characteristic field, a nef line is semiample iff its restriction to E(L) is semiample.

items.name: Keel finite-union semiampleness
items.statement: For X=X1∪X2 with L|X1 semiample and L|X2 nef, the exceptional-locus hypothesis E(L|X2)⊂X1 makes L semiample, with the precise reduced gluing setup of Lemma1.8.

items.name: Powers descend across universal homeomorphisms
items.statement: For a finite universal homeomorphism in characteristic p, sufficiently high p-powers of sections of a pulled-back line descend; the Picard comparison becomes an isomorphism after inverting p under Keel’s hypotheses.

items.name: Ample-plus-effective reduction
items.statement: If L=A+D with A ample and D effective Cartier on a projective scheme, then E(L)⊂D, and semiampleness reduces to the restriction to D in the precise nef setting of Keel1.6–1.7.

items.name: Semiampleness on the resolution
items.statement: The line ψ*L is semiample.

items.name: Semiample contraction and relation comparison
items.statement: A sufficiently high power of ψ*L defines a contraction Gr-tilde_λ→X after Stein factorization, with X a perfect projective scheme. Compare its reduced closed equivalence relation with that induced by ψ.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G819.construct
api.statement: Construct the contraction from a basepoint-free power on a finite-type model.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G819.characterise
api.statement: Compare the two relations after algebraically closed field points using connected contracted curves and strict positivity.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G819.transport
api.statement: Pass equality of reduced perfect closed relations to their v-sheaf coequalizers.

uses.how: Proves representability without assuming Zhu’s alternate theorem.

items.name: Projectivity of bounded Witt Grassmannians
items.statement: Gr≤λ is the perfection of a projective F_p-variety, proper pfp as a perfect scheme, and its canonical determinant line L is ample.

items.name: Ramified Witt coefficient ring
items.statement: For a complete mixed-characteristic discrete valuation field K with perfect residue field k, set W_OK(R)=W(R)⊗_{W(k)}O_K on perfect k-algebras.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G901.construct
api.statement: Form the finite base extension using the specified W(k)-algebra structure on O_K.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G901.characterise
api.statement: Compare reduction by a uniformizer with R and localization with the loop coefficient field algebra.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G901.transport
api.statement: Transport along perfect k-algebra maps.

uses.how: Supplies ramified loop groups and the determinant normalization.

items.name: Mixed-characteristic loop groups
items.statement: For a smooth affine O_K-group scheme G with generic fibre G_K, define L+G(R)=G(W_OK(R)) and LG(R)=G_K(W_OK(R)[1/p]).

api.name: BhattScholze17.G902.construct
api.statement: Define group-valued functors with multiplication and inversion.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G902.characterise
api.statement: Include the positive loop group in the full loop group.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G902.transport
api.statement: Base change coefficients and compare faithful matrix representations.

uses.how: Defines the fpqc affine-Grassmann quotient.

items.name: Loop representability
items.statement: L+G is represented by a perfect affine scheme, and LG by a strict ind-affine perfect scheme.

items.name: Affine Grassmannian of an integral group model
items.statement: Gr_G is the fpqc sheaf quotient LG/L+G on perfect k-algebras.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G904.construct
api.statement: Sheafify the action quotient with its specified topology.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G904.characterise
api.statement: Compare GLn points with W_OK-lattices, retaining descent for locally free modules.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G904.transport
api.statement: Construct maps induced by integral group homomorphisms.

uses.how: Extends projectivity to parahoric groups.

items.name: Integral-model ind-quasi-projectivity
items.statement: For a smooth affine O_K-model with connected reductive generic fibre, Gr_G is a strict ind-quasi-projective perfect scheme.

items.name: Parahoric ind-projectivity
items.statement: If G is a parahoric O_K-model, Gr_G is ind-projective in perfect schemes.

items.name: Kottwitz connected components
items.statement: For a parahoric model, π0(LG)=π0(Gr_G)=π1(G_K)_Gal(K), compatibly with the Kottwitz map.

items.name: Normalized determinant for SLn lattices
items.statement: On the determinant-trivial lattice Grassmannian, define L from det-tilde(p^a W_OK^n/M) for a sufficiently negative bound a, with the fixed standard-lattice normalization and coherent independence of a.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G1001.construct
api.statement: Construct the supported quotient and its determinant line.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G1001.characterise
api.statement: Compare successive bounds by the fixed determinant of the standard quotient.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G1001.transport
api.statement: Transport the normalized line along the SLn loop action.

uses.how: Defines the determinant central extension.

items.name: Determinant central extension
items.statement: The extension of LSLn has pairs (g,α) with α:g*L≅L; compose by pullback and composition of the line isomorphisms.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G1002.construct
api.statement: Define the pair group with its coherent multiplication.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G1002.characterise
api.statement: Identify kernel elements with automorphisms of L.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G1002.transport
api.statement: Construct the projection and compare its pullback to field-valued points.

uses.how: Connects the geometric line with the K2 boundary extension.

items.name: Exact determinant extension
items.statement: The determinant construction gives a Zariski-sheaf exact central extension 1→Gm→LSLn-tilde→LSLn→1.

items.name: K2 boundary comparison
items.statement: On k-points the determinant central extension is the pushout of the stable K2(K) extension pulled back to SLn(K), along the localization boundary K2(K)→K1(k)=k×.

items.name: Infinite-dimensional sections
items.statement: For the nontrivial SLn affine Grassmannian and m>0, H0(Gr,L^m) is infinite-dimensional over k. The argument uses n≥2 and its nontrivial projective bounds.

items.name: Enhanced unbounded quasi-coherent complexes
items.statement: Dqc(X) is the stable enhanced category of unbounded quasi-coherent complexes on a qcqs scheme, with derived tensor, coherent pullback and derived pushforward; on affines it is the module category of the ring spectrum.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1101.construct
api.statement: Construct the enhancement and compare its homotopy category to the ordinary derived category.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1101.characterise
api.statement: Identify the affine category with derived modules and its perfect objects with dualizable ones.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1101.transport
api.statement: Construct pullback, pushforward and their adjunction with coherent base-change maps.

uses.how: The category-valued descent target.

items.name: Tor-amplitude strata
items.statement: Perf[a,b](R) is the core space of perfect R-complexes with Tor-amplitude in [a,b], detected by tensoring with residue fields. Its mapping spaces are (b−a)-truncated and its object space is (b−a+1)-truncated.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1102.construct
api.statement: Define the full core by uniform Tor-amplitude bounds.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1102.characterise
api.statement: Prove the corrected finite truncation bound from the mapping-complex amplitude.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1102.transport
api.statement: Commute this functor with filtered ring colimits and descend the amplitude condition.

uses.how: The finite truncation needed to apply Corollary2.14 must include the extra degree.

items.name: Animated commutative rings
items.statement: Use simplicial commutative rings localized at weak equivalences, with derived tensor products and homotopy groups, and with Frobenius on animated F_p-algebras.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1103.construct
api.statement: Construct free animated rings and their homotopy groups from simplicial models.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1103.characterise
api.statement: Compare ordinary rings with discrete animated rings.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1103.transport
api.statement: Construct Frobenius and derived pushouts functorially.

uses.how: Perfectness removes derived higher homotopy.

items.name: Perfect animated Fp-algebras are discrete
items.statement: If Frobenius is invertible on an animated F_p-algebra A, then π_i(A)=0 for i>0.

items.name: Cosimplicial perfection is different
items.statement: An analogous discreteness assertion fails for cosimplicial commutative F_p-algebras: perfected ordinary elliptic-curve cohomology can retain H1.

items.name: Multiplication at the zero component
items.statement: For an animated commutative ring A and i>0, the map π_i(A×A,(0,0))→π_i(A,0) induced by multiplication is zero.

items.name: Perfection forgets derived structure
items.statement: The perfection of a derived F_p-scheme agrees with the perfection of its classical truncation.

items.name: Perfect-ring pushouts are already derived
items.statement: For maps A→B,A→C of perfect F_p-algebras, B⊗^L_A C is discrete and equals the ordinary perfect-ring tensor product; the analogous comparison holds for colimits of perfect rings.

items.name: Imperfect bases invalidate the tensor shortcut
items.statement: When A is an imperfect field and B=C=A_perf, the ordinary tensor B⊗_A C can have nonzero nilpotents; the perfect-base condition in the preceding comparison cannot be dropped.

items.name: Stable monoidal homotopy theory
items.statement: A stable homotopy theory here is a presentable symmetric monoidal stable infinity-category whose tensor product preserves colimits separately, with modules over commutative algebra objects.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1114.construct
api.statement: Specify stability, presentability and the colimit-preserving tensor.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1114.characterise
api.statement: Construct commutative algebra objects and their module categories.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1114.transport
api.statement: Transport algebra and module objects along appropriately monoidal colimit-preserving functors.

uses.how: The shared setting for descendability.

items.name: Descendable algebra map
items.statement: A→B is descendable when the unit A lies in the thick tensor ideal generated by B, equivalently when the augmented truncated Amitsur totalization tower is pro-constant with value A.
items.locator: Definition11.14; Mathew v1 Definition3.17 and Proposition3.19

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1115.construct
api.statement: Construct the Amitsur cosimplicial algebra and its finite totalization tower.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1115.characterise
api.statement: Compare thick tensor generation with the pro-constant criterion.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1115.transport
api.statement: Base change a descendable map and transport its witnesses.

uses.how: Converts geometric covers into coherent descent.

items.name: Module-category descent
items.statement: For a descendable algebra map A→B, Mod(A) is equivalent to the totalization of Mod(B^tensor_A(•+1)), with its full coherent descent data.

items.name: Completion is weaker than descendability
items.statement: Z_p→F_p is not descendable, although its Amitsur totalization recovers the p-complete unit: after inverting p, extension of scalars kills a nonzero module.

items.name: Composition of descendability
items.statement: For A→B→C, if A→B and B→C are descendable then A→C is descendable.

items.name: Right cancellation of descendability
items.statement: For A→B→C, if A→C is descendable then A→B is descendable.

items.name: Descendability index
items.statement: For F=fib(A→B), the map has index at most m if the m-fold tensor map F^tensor_A m→A is nullhomotopic, with m a nonnegative integer; at m=0 the tensor power is A, so the bound requires the unit object itself to be zero.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1120.construct
api.statement: Record a specified nullhomotopy of the m-fold fibre map.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1120.characterise
api.statement: A larger nonnegative bound follows from a smaller one by tensoring the witness; index zero only occurs when the unit is zero.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1120.transport
api.statement: Preserve a bound under base change and the functors of Lemma11.20.

uses.how: A uniform finite index permits passage to Frobenius colimits.

items.name: Finite index characterizes descendability
items.statement: An algebra map is descendable iff it has finite descendability index.
items.locator: Lemma11.20 first assertion; Mathew v1 Proposition3.26

items.name: Functorial preservation of the index
items.statement: A colimit-preserving lax symmetric monoidal functor between the stable settings of Lemma11.20 preserves an established finite descendability index on the induced algebra map.

items.name: A quantitative open-cover example
items.statement: For R=Z[a,b,c,d]/(ab+cd−1), the cover D(a)⊔D(c) is descendable with index at most five. The proof uses dim R=4 and its Gorenstein injective-dimension bound.

items.name: No unrestricted filtered-colimit stability
items.statement: A filtered colimit of descendable maps need not be descendable when their indices are unbounded; a locally nilpotent but nonnilpotent quotient ideal supplies the example.

items.name: Uniform-index sequential colimits
items.statement: For a sequential filtered diagram of algebra maps whose descendability indices admit one finite bound, the colimit map is descendable.
items.locator: Lemma11.22, case proved in the paper

items.name: Uniform-index colimits in finite cohomological dimension
items.statement: The uniform-index assertion extends to index categories of finite cohomological dimension, as announced in Lemma11.22; the paper only writes the sequential proof.

items.name: Finite open covers are descendable
items.statement: For a finite qc open cover U_i of a qcqs scheme X, O_X→product_i Rj_i,* O_Ui is descendable.

items.name: Fppf covers are descendable
items.statement: An fppf cover in the qcqs setting gives a descendable structure-algebra map.

items.name: Nilpotent quotients are descendable
items.statement: A closed immersion defined by a nilpotent ideal gives a descendable structure-algebra map.

items.name: Pushforward preserves descendability
items.statement: For a qcqs morphism f, derived pushforward carries a descendable algebra map in Dqc(X) to a descendable map of the resulting algebras in Dqc(Y).

items.name: Countably generated faithfully flat algebras
items.statement: The paper notes descendability of a faithfully flat algebra that is countably generated over the base, by reducing to countably presented faithfully flat subalgebras as in the cited argument.

items.name: Noetherian h-covers are descendable
items.statement: For an h-cover f:X→Y of noetherian schemes, O_Y→Rf_*O_X is descendable.

items.name: Descent for noetherian schemes
items.statement: For an h-cover X→S of noetherian schemes, Dqc(S) is the limit of Dqc on the derived Čech nerve X/S.

items.name: Perfect and pseudocoherent objects detected by h-descent
items.statement: In the noetherian setting of Theorem11.12, an object is perfect or pseudocoherent iff its h-cover pullback is so, with the corresponding descent equivalences.

items.name: Derived h-hyperdescent counterexample
items.statement: For derived schemes an h-hypercover obtained by repeated classical truncation can fail perfect-complex hyperdescent; for A=Sym_C(C[2]) the nonzero localization inverting its positive-degree generator is killed by truncation.

items.name: Finite-presentation converse to descendability
items.statement: For a finitely presented map of noetherian rings A→B, Spec B→Spec A is an h-cover iff A→B is descendable.

items.name: Perfect h-covers are descendable
items.statement: For an h-cover f:X→Y of perfect schemes, O_Y→Rf_*O_X is descendable.

items.name: Quasi-coherent h-descent on perfect schemes
items.statement: The category-valued presheaf X↦Dqc(X) satisfies h-descent on perfect schemes.

items.name: Hypercomplete v-descent for Perf(X)
items.statement: On perfect schemes, X↦Perf(X) satisfies hypercomplete v-descent.

items.name: Hypercomplete v-descent for Perf(W_n(X))
items.statement: On perfect schemes, X↦Perf(W_n(X)) satisfies hypercomplete v-descent.

items.name: Hypercomplete v-descent for Perf(W(X))
items.statement: On perfect schemes, X↦Perf(W(X)) satisfies hypercomplete v-descent.

items.name: Hypercomplete v-descent for Perf(W(X) on X)
items.statement: On perfect schemes, X↦Perf(W(X) on X) satisfies hypercomplete v-descent.

items.name: Derived abstract-blowup patching
items.statement: For an abstract blowup square of perfect schemes, Dqc(Y) is the homotopy fibre product of Dqc(X) and Dqc(Z) over Dqc(E).

items.name: Finite Tor dimension of perfect finite-presentation maps
items.statement: A pfp algebra over a perfect ring has finite Tor dimension; for a quotient of a perfect polynomial algebra defined by the radical of m generators, the quotient step has Tor dimension at most m.

items.name: Boundedness is h-local
items.statement: For an h-cover f:X→Y in Perf and K∈Dqc(Y), boundedness of f*K implies boundedness of K.

items.name: Finite global dimension after perfection
items.statement: Let k be the perfection of a regular ring of finite Krull dimension and R a pfp k-algebra. Then R has finite global dimension. If R is a quotient of P=P0_perf with P0 regular of dimension d, the proof gives the bound d+1.

items.name: Bounded complexes admit bounded projective representatives
items.statement: Under Proposition11.31, bounded Dqc objects are locally represented by bounded complexes of projective modules, which may have infinite rank.

items.name: Intrinsic Tor-dimension bound
items.statement: If k is a perfect field and R a pfp k-algebra of dimension d, its Tor dimension is at most 2d, as explained in Remark11.33.

items.name: The earlier dimension bound fails
items.statement: For R=(k[x,y]/xy)_perf, the ordinary modules R/(x) and R/(y) have nonzero Tor2. Thus the old bound Tor-dim R≤dim R is false. The ideals (x),(y) here are not radical.

items.name: Intrinsic global bound announced in the correction
items.statement: Remark11.33 footnote24 states the additional bound global-dim R≤2dim R+1 for pfp algebras over a perfect field, without a proof in this paper.

items.name: Kunz converse via perfection
items.statement: For a noetherian ring of characteristic p, flatness of Frobenius implies regularity; the proof can be recovered using finite Tor dimension of a perfected regular presentation and faithful flatness.

items.name: Tensor commutes with a bounded cosimplicial totalization
items.statement: Let R have finite global dimension, M∈D(R), and N• a cosimplicial diagram of discrete R-modules with bounded totalization. Then M⊗^L_R Tot(N•)→Tot(M⊗^L_R N•) is an equivalence.

items.name: Hyperdescent of derived sections
items.statement: For X pfp over a base as in Proposition11.31 and K∈Dqc(X), the functor Y↦RΓ(Y,f*K) on X’s pfp h-site is hypercomplete.

items.name: Relative truncation preserves hypercompleteness
items.statement: In an infinity-topos, an n-truncated map to a hypercomplete object has hypercomplete source.

items.name: Hypercomplete h-descent of unbounded Dqc
items.statement: For k the perfection of a regular finite-dimensional ring, Dqc on pfp k-schemes is a hypercomplete h-sheaf of categories.

items.name: Derived Witt vectors and operators
items.statement: Apply Witt-vector functors termwise to simplicial F_p-algebras to obtain derived W and W_n, with Frobenius F and Verschiebung V satisfying FV=VF=p.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1153.construct
api.statement: Construct termwise Witt functors and their homotopy-invariant derived interpretation.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1153.characterise
api.statement: Compare truncation and the F,V identities.

api.name: BhattScholze17.Q1153.transport
api.statement: Transport along animated algebra maps and derived Čech diagrams.

uses.how: Removes derived structure after inverting Frobenius.

items.name: Frobenius-inverted derived Witt discreteness
items.statement: For an animated F_p-algebra A, W(A)[1/F]→W(π0A)[1/F] is an equivalence; the analogous finite-level assertion holds.

items.name: p-torsion comparison cone
items.statement: The cone of W(A)→W(π0A) is killed by p, as asserted in Remark11.44 using F,V and the preceding argument.

items.name: Frobenius-inverted Witt blowup excision
items.statement: For the Cartesian square of Lemma11.45 with affine base, constructible closed center and structure-cohomology excision, Frobenius-inverted Witt cohomology has the corresponding distinguished triangle, including all iterated self-products required by Čech descent.

items.name: Frobenius-inverted Witt h-descent
items.statement: For a noetherian F_p-scheme S of finite Krull dimension, X↦RΓ(X,W O_X)[1/F] satisfies h-descent on finitely presented S-schemes.

items.name: Blowup contraction used for Witt descent
items.statement: After thickening the exceptional divisor of a blowup in the proof of Proposition11.41, the relevant pushout exists and maps to the original base by a finite universal homeomorphism, giving the excision square used by Lemma11.45.

items.name: Rational Witt h-descent
items.statement: Under the hypotheses of Proposition11.41, rational Witt cohomology RΓ(X,W O_X)[1/p] satisfies h-descent; this recovers the Berthelot–Bloch–Esnault theorem cited as Theorem11.40.

items.name: Self-braiding-trivial symmetric category
items.statement: A symmetric monoidal category is called strict in Definition12.1 when c_(X,X)=id for every object X. This is a self-braiding condition, separate from strict associativity and unit constraints.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1201.construct
api.statement: Define the self-braiding predicate on an existing symmetric monoidal category.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1201.characterise
api.statement: Test the predicate on Pic, graded Pic and vector spaces under direct sum.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1201.transport
api.statement: Transport it under symmetric monoidal equivalence.

uses.how: Explains why the signed graded target is necessary.

items.name: Symmetric monoidal determinant of vector bundles
items.statement: The functor E↦(top exterior power E, rank E) from Vect(X) with direct sum to Pic^Z(X) with tensor is symmetric monoidal.

items.name: Segal E-infinity monoid
items.statement: An E-infinity monoid is a functor Fin*→Spaces such that X([n])→X([1])^n is an equivalence for every n≥0; π0X([1]) is a commutative monoid.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1204.construct
api.statement: Define the pointed finite-set diagram and all Segal maps.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1204.characterise
api.statement: Recover unit and coherently commutative multiplication from collapse maps.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1204.transport
api.statement: Construct maps as natural transformations preserving the diagram.

uses.how: Supplies the input of group completion.

items.name: Coherent subset construction
items.statement: For a symmetric monoidal category, construct its Fin*-diagram using families X_T indexed by all subsets T of the nonbasepoint set, with coherent tensor identifications for disjoint unions; take the nerve of the maximal subgroupoid.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1205.construct
api.statement: Provide subset objects, empty-set unit and disjoint-union isomorphisms with associativity and symmetry compatibility.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1205.characterise
api.statement: Use inverse images of subsets to obtain a strict diagram at the model level.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1205.transport
api.statement: Compare its value at [n] with n copies of the core nerve.

uses.how: Turns symmetric monoidal categories into K-theory inputs.

items.name: Grouplike E-infinity monoid
items.statement: An E-infinity monoid is grouplike when π0 is an abelian group.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1207.construct
api.statement: Define invertibility of connected components.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1207.characterise
api.statement: Compare this with the shear maps becoming equivalences.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1207.transport
api.statement: Transport grouplikeness under E-infinity equivalences.

uses.how: Distinguishes monoids from connective-spectrum inputs.

items.name: Connective spectrum via deloopings
items.statement: A connective spectrum is modeled by a sequence of spaces X_i with X_i≃ΩX_(i+1), where X_i has π_j=0 for j<i. The paper’s connectivity convention is this displayed vanishing condition.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1208.construct
api.statement: Give the sequence, loop equivalences and connectivity witnesses.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1208.characterise
api.statement: Recover homotopy groups and the infinite-loop-space functor.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1208.transport
api.statement: Construct spectrum maps compatible with every delooping.

uses.how: Receives group-completed symmetric monoidal categories.

items.name: Infinite-loop-space equivalence
items.statement: Grouplike E-infinity monoids are equivalent to connective spectra.

items.name: Bar construction and delooping
items.statement: For an E-infinity monoid X, form BX as the geometric realization of the simplicial bar diagram with degree n equal to X^n. The canonical X→ΩBX is an equivalence precisely in the grouplike case.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1210.construct
api.statement: Construct faces by multiplication, degeneracies by the unit and the realization.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1210.characterise
api.statement: Produce the canonical loop comparison and its multiplication coherence.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1210.transport
api.statement: Iterate the bar construction with its connectivity estimate.

uses.how: Defines group completion through a genuine delooping.

items.name: Components of the looped bar construction
items.statement: π0(ΩBX)=π1(BX); for a grouplike X this is π0(X).

items.name: Group completion
items.statement: The functor X↦X_gp=ΩBX is left adjoint to the inclusion of grouplike E-infinity monoids into all E-infinity monoids.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1212.construct
api.statement: Construct the universal map X→X_gp.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1212.characterise
api.statement: Identify maps from X_gp to a grouplike target with maps from X.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1212.transport
api.statement: Transport completion along symmetric monoidal functors and compare π0 with ordinary monoid group completion.

uses.how: Supplies the symmetric-monoidal model of algebraic K-theory.

items.name: K-theory of a symmetric monoidal category
items.statement: K(C) is the connective spectrum corresponding to the group completion of the E-infinity space constructed from the maximal subgroupoid of C.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1213.construct
api.statement: Apply the subset-diagram construction to the core and then group completion.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1213.characterise
api.statement: Keep automorphisms through the nerve rather than passing to object classes.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1213.transport
api.statement: Construct spectrum maps from symmetric monoidal functors.

uses.how: Provides the split exact projective-module K model.

items.name: Abstract Picard groupoid
items.statement: A Picard groupoid is a symmetric monoidal groupoid in which every object is tensor-invertible, with all monoidal coherence retained.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1214.construct
api.statement: Specify the groupoid, tensor structure and inverse-object witnesses.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1214.characterise
api.statement: Identify π0 as a group and π1 as the automorphisms of the unit.

api.name: BhattScholze17.A1214.transport
api.statement: Construct symmetric monoidal functors and equivalences.

uses.how: Owns the general notion shared with other Picard descent papers.

items.name: Picard groupoids and truncated spectra
items.statement: The core nerve of a symmetric monoidal groupoid is grouplike iff the groupoid is Picard; Picard groupoids are equivalent to connective spectra with homotopy only in degrees zero and one.

items.name: Projective-module K-theory spectrum
items.statement: For a commutative ring R, K(R) is K of finite projective R-modules with direct sum, compared by the split exact/additivity theorem with the common algebraic K-theory model.

items.name: Spectral determinant for rings
items.statement: The symmetric monoidal determinant induces a natural map K(R)→Pic^Z(R) of connective spectra.

items.name: Zariski-sheafified low K-theory
items.statement: The determinant identifies Pic^Z with the Zariski sheafification of τ≤1K on affine schemes. This is not an unsheafified equivalence on every ring.

items.name: Restriction of scalars on ramified support K-theory
items.statement: Since W_OK(R) is finite free over W(R), restricting scalars carries perfect W_OK(R)-complexes acyclic after p-inversion to perfect supported W(R)-complexes and induces a K-theory map.

items.name: Incidence parameters of the first filtration quotient
items.statement: Put μ=type(Q), V=Q/pQ, r=n_μ(0)−n_λ(0), and K_m=ker(p^m:Q/pQ→p^mQ/p^(m+1)Q). For μ≤λ, the first quotient kernel F has dimension r and must satisfy dim(F∩K_m)≥a_m=r+sum_(i≥m+1)(n_μ(i)−n_λ(i)). The K_m increase with m; reverse the finite indexing to apply the decreasing-filtration Lemma7.14.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G717.construct
api.statement: Construct K_m and a_m from the two partitions.

api.name: BhattScholze17.G717.characterise
api.statement: Compute length(p^m Fil1Q)=length(p^mQ)−n_μ(m)+r−dim(F∩K_m).

api.name: BhattScholze17.G717.transport
api.statement: Prove a_m≤r and a_m≤dim K_m from dominance, then transport the incidence locus to a reversed filtration.

uses.how: Specifies the exact inequalities used in resolution-fibre cohomology.

items.name: GLn lattice quotient comparison
items.statement: For perfect k-algebra R, Gr_GLn(R) identifies with finite projective W_OK(R)-submodules M⊂W_OK(R)[1/p]^n that become the full module after p-inversion.

items.name: SLn determinant-trivial lattice comparison
items.statement: Gr_SLn is the subfunctor of Gr_GLn whose determinant lattice is the standard W_OK(R) lattice in its fraction algebra, with the trivialization induced by that embedding.

items.name: Restriction of sections to perfect projective bounds
items.statement: For a bounded perfect projective closed stage X⊂Gr_SLn and m≥1, H0(Gr_SLn,L^m)→H0(X,L^m) is surjective. If dim X>0 the target is infinite-dimensional.

items.name: Right cancellation of universal descent
items.statement: If X→Y→Z has composite X→Z of universal F-descent, then Y→Z is of universal F-descent.

items.name: Formal Witt vector-bundle descent
items.statement: X↦Vect(W(X)) is a v-stack on perfect schemes.

items.name: Gorenstein faithful-flat index bound
items.statement: If A is a noetherian Gorenstein ring of dimension d and A→B is faithfully flat, its descendability index is at most d+1.

items.name: Question 10.6 (statement only)
items.statement: (i) Construct an explicit nonzero section of L (or a power) on Gr_SLn; (ii) describe H⁰(Gr_SLn, L^⊗m) as an LG-representation and decide topological irreducibility; (iii) is Pic(Gr_SLn) = Z[1/p]·L?; (iv) for split simple simply connected G, is Pic(Gr_G) ≅ Z[1/p]·L_G with a specified generator?; and the remaining parts on the K2 comparison and finite-type structures, as listed under openQuestions.
